name: dispatch_object_state_machine
description: Advances one game object's state machine once per update, selecting one of about twenty states from its state byte. Each state writes sprite coordinates or animation timers, updates score and counter globals, and stores the next handler, branching on a coordinate field compared against fixed thresholds.

name: return_without_action
description: The body is a bare return with no instructions, so calling it does nothing. It is referenced only through address-taken pointers and serves as a no-op handler.

name: dispatch_gated_object_state
description: Decrements a per-object timer and returns while it is nonzero. Otherwise it passes a shared counter gate chosen by a coordinate threshold, then runs the same state dispatch as the main object handler.

name: dispatch_counted_object_state
description: Returns early when a shared counter exceeds four, otherwise increments it and runs the object state dispatch. The counter appears to cap how many objects are processed in one update.

name: dispatch_threshold_gated_state
description: Gated variant of the object state dispatch: when a coordinate exceeds a threshold it returns once a shared counter passes four, otherwise it increments the counter. It then runs the same state switch as the main handler.

name: load_position_from_pointer
description: Copies the first word of a structure referenced by the object's pointer field into the object, and stores that structure's second word minus sixteen into the object's next field.

name: step_object_toward_target
description: Moves the object's coordinate by a per-object speed until it reaches the stored target. On arrival it clears the frame counter and runs the state switch, the same dispatch as the main handler.

name: store_d1_into_object_field
description: Stores the 16-bit value passed in data register D1 into the object's word field at offset two and returns. It is a plain field setter.

name: run_motion_script_step
description: Advances an object's motion script: while its frame counter is nonzero it moves the position by the stored velocity and counts down. When the counter expires it reads the next command byte, which either adds an offset or loads new velocity and duration values.

name: add_stream_byte_to_offset
description: Adds the byte at the source stream to a 16-bit offset field of the object, then advances the stream pointer by one byte. It is used to step through a byte-encoded data stream.

name: dispatch_state_unless_flagged
description: When the flag byte at the source pointer is nonzero, it clears two offset fields and returns. Otherwise it zeroes the frame counter and runs the standard state dispatch.

name: advance_object_by_tile_table
description: Derives a grid offset from the object's coordinates using an 82-byte row stride, reads three words from the grid, and uses two top bits to index a table of movement deltas. The delta is added to the object's position, which is then checked against bounds stored in the object.

name: dispatch_object_state_direct
description: Clears the frame counter and runs the object state switch directly, with no gate. Several state handlers call it to advance the object to its next state.

name: record_row_then_dispatch
description: On a trigger frame it writes two bytes into a shared record buffer and advances that buffer pointer while it stays in range, then runs the state dispatch. On other frames it returns, clearing two offset fields only when the frame counter reaches its end value.

name: record_row_then_dispatch_variant
description: Behaves like its neighbour: a coordinate row check decides whether to write two bytes into the shared record buffer before dispatching. Off the trigger row it returns, or clears the offset fields at the end value.

name: scan_tile_row_movement
description: Measures how far the object can slide along a row of a 41-cell tile map before a solid tile is hit, adds that distance to its coordinate, and adjusts its speed field. Once the coordinate passes its stored limit it runs the state dispatch.

name: scan_tile_row_then_dispatch
description: Scans ahead along a 41-cell tile row to find how far the object can slide, then applies that distance to its coordinate. When the coordinate passes its limit it clears the frame counter and runs the state dispatch.

name: ease_position_toward_limit
description: Steps a position field one unit toward a limit stored in the object, or when a shared flag is set moves it to the limit within a three-unit step. Used to track a target coordinate smoothly.

name: track_position_with_clamp
description: Applies a clamped three-unit tracking step to a position field while a shared flag is set and the coordinate stays below its upper bound. Otherwise it leaves the field unchanged.

name: clamp_value_to_minimum
description: Subtracts three from the value in data register D1, raises the result to a minimum taken from data register D2 when it falls below it, and stores it at the address in A0.

name: gate_dispatch_on_mode_flag
description: Returns while a shared mode byte is two or a status flag has its low bits set. Otherwise it sets another shared flag to three, clears the frame counter and runs the object state switch.

name: return_without_action
description: The body is a bare return with no instructions, so calling it does nothing. It is referenced only through address-taken pointers and serves as a no-op handler.

name: dispatch_when_mode_low
description: Returns unless a shared mode byte is one or less. Otherwise it clears the frame counter and runs the object state switch.

name: initialize_object_state_two
description: Sets an object's state byte to two and writes the fixed bound words 82 and 149 into its limit fields. It also installs the shared state dispatch as the object's handler.

name: initialize_object_state_three
description: Sets an object's state byte to three and writes the fixed bound words 154 and 221 into its limit fields. It also installs the shared state dispatch as the object's handler.

name: select_next_object_state
description: Chooses the object's next state index from its position word and the shared route flags, using a near-range check on that word. It stores the chosen state and installs the shared dispatch as the handler.

name: store_mode_and_pointer
description: Sets a shared route flag, then stores the byte from data register D1 at the object's mode field and the pointer from A1 into its pointer field.

name: check_route_availability_state
description: Checks shared route flags and a position word to see whether a route can be used. It then sets the object's state to four and installs the shared dispatch as its handler.

name: select_route_pointer_for_state
description: Picks a route pointer for the object from the shared flags, stores it in the object, sets its state to four and installs the shared dispatch as its handler.

name: set_fixed_route_and_state
description: Stores a fixed route pointer in the object, sets its state to four and installs the shared dispatch as its handler.

name: reserve_slot_and_set_state
description: Reserves one of two shared slots by decrementing its count, and writes the object's position word from the slot index times fourteen plus an offset. It then sets state five or six by the object's type byte and installs the shared dispatch.

name: reserve_slot_six_state
description: Reserves the second shared slot by decrementing its count, writes the object's position word from that slot index times fourteen plus an offset, and moves the object to state six.

name: record_event_set_state_seven
description: Increments one of two shared event counters chosen by a coordinate threshold, adds 100 to the matching running total, and stores that total in the object. It sets a flag and moves the object to state seven.

name: increment_event_count_state_seven
description: Increments a shared event counter, adds 100 to its running total, stores the total in the object, sets a flag, and moves the object to state seven.

name: record_event_set_state_fourteen
description: Increments one of two shared event counters chosen by a coordinate threshold, adds 125 to the matching running total, and stores it in the object. It sets a flag and moves the object to state fourteen.

name: increment_event_count_state_fourteen
description: Increments a shared event counter, adds 125 to its running total, stores the total in the object, sets a flag, and moves the object to state fourteen.

name: release_event_set_state_eight
description: Decrements one of two shared event counters chosen by a coordinate threshold, clears a flag and moves the object to state eight with the shared dispatch as its handler.

name: release_event_count_state_eight
description: Decrements a shared event counter, clears a flag, and moves the object to state eight with the shared dispatch as its handler.

name: set_launch_positions_by_side
description: Sets the object's three position words from one of two fixed sets chosen by a coordinate threshold. It stores the offset word as a shared value plus 940 and moves the object to state ten or nine.

name: set_launch_positions_state_ten
description: Sets the object's three position words to fixed values, stores a shared value plus 940 as its offset word, and moves the object to state ten.

name: set_bounds_and_state_twenty
description: Sets two object bound words to zero and one hundred, then moves the object to state twenty with the shared dispatch as its handler.

name: decrement_counter_set_state_eleven
description: Decrements a shared counter, then either installs the shared dispatch or sets the object's timer to 384 and a flag to three. The object moves to state eleven.

name: set_timer_and_mode_byte
description: Sets the object's timer to 384 and a flag to three, stores the byte from data register D1 as its mode, and installs the shared dispatch as its handler.

name: set_state_twelve_low_count
description: Sets a shared flag when a counter is below six, installs the shared dispatch as the object's handler, and moves the object to state twelve.

name: step_position_set_state_thirteen
description: Decrements the object's first position word and, when a shared flag is set and a count is below six, adds a shared offset to its vertical field. The object then moves to state thirteen.

name: set_flag_and_state_thirtyone
description: Sets a shared flag, installs the shared dispatch as the object's handler, and moves the object to state thirty-one.

name: snap_position_grid_state_six
description: When a shared value is zero, snaps the object's first position field to a 14-unit grid. It then clears a flag, installs the shared dispatch, and moves the object to state six.

name: arm_side_counter_and_state
description: Sets one of two shared side counters to twelve, chosen by a coordinate threshold. It sets the object's timer to eight and moves the object to state thirty-three.

name: store_side_counter_and_state
description: Stores the value from data register D1 in a shared side counter, sets the object's timer to eight, and moves the object to state thirty-three.

name: release_side_counter_set_state
description: Decrements one of two shared counters chosen by a coordinate threshold and sets the object's timer to 384 or 540 to match. It sets a flag to three and moves the object to state seventeen or fifteen.

name: release_counter_set_state_seventeen
description: Decrements a shared counter, sets the object's timer to 384 and a flag to three, clears another flag, and moves the object to state seventeen.

name: set_bounds_and_state_sixteen
description: Sets two object bound words to 218 and 288, then moves the object to state sixteen with the shared dispatch as its handler.

name: decrement_counter_pick_state
description: Decrements a shared counter, then when the object's first position word equals 218 it sets another shared value to fourteen and selects state twenty-one. Otherwise it keeps the state passed in data register D1 and installs the shared dispatch.

name: set_state_from_argument
description: Installs the shared dispatch as the object's handler and stores the byte from data register D1 as the object's state.

name: set_state_eighteen_low_count
description: Sets a shared flag when a counter is below six, installs the shared dispatch as the object's handler, and moves the object to state eighteen.

name: advance_position_set_state_nineteen
description: Increments the object's first position word and, when a shared flag is set and a count is below six, adds a shared offset to its vertical field. The object then moves to state nineteen.

name: set_flag_and_state_thirtytwo
description: Sets a shared flag, installs the shared dispatch as the object's handler, and moves the object to state thirty-two.

name: snap_position_grid_state_five
description: When a shared value is zero, snaps the object's first position field to a 14-unit grid with an offset of eight. It then clears a flag, installs the shared dispatch, and moves the object to state five.

name: decrement_counter_check_zero_state
description: Decrements a shared counter, then when the object's first position word is nonzero sets another shared value to fourteen and selects state twenty-one. Otherwise it keeps the state passed in data register D1 and installs the shared dispatch.

name: set_state_from_argument
description: Installs the shared dispatch as the object's handler and stores the byte from data register D1 as the object's state.

name: set_timer_by_position_state
description: When the object's first position word is below 161, sets its timer to 150 or 50 depending on a shared flag, raises a flag, and moves it to state twenty-two. Otherwise it sets the timer to 100 and moves it to state twenty-three.

name: set_timer_state_twentytwo
description: Sets the object's timer to 150 or 50 depending on a shared flag, raises a flag, installs the shared dispatch, and moves the object to state twenty-two.

name: set_fixed_timer_state_twentytwo
description: Sets the object's timer to 150, raises a flag, and moves the object to state twenty-two with the shared dispatch as its handler.

name: set_state_twentyfour
description: Sets the object's state to twenty-four and installs the shared dispatch as its handler.

name: set_state_twentyfour
description: Sets the object's state to twenty-four and installs the shared dispatch as its handler.

name: spawn_object_into_free_slot
description: Registers the object in one of two shared slots, choosing its start position from a coordinate threshold and a shared flag. It increments the slot counter and moves the object to state twenty-five.

name: register_object_in_primary_slot
description: Stores the object in the primary shared slot, sets its position from the two input coordinates in data registers D2 and D3, and moves it to state twenty-five with the shared dispatch as its handler.

name: spawn_object_at_side_position
description: Registers the object in one of two shared slots at a fixed horizontal position, choosing the vertical start from a shared flag. It increments the slot counter and moves the object to state twenty-five.

name: register_object_in_primary_slot
description: Stores the object in the primary shared slot, sets its position from the two input coordinates in data registers D2 and D3, and moves it to state twenty-five with the shared dispatch as its handler.

name: spawn_object_at_fixed_point
description: Registers the object in one of two shared slots at a fixed start position, increments the slot counter, and moves the object to state twenty-five.

name: register_object_in_primary_slot
description: Stores the object in the primary shared slot, sets its position from the two input coordinates in data registers D2 and D3, and moves it to state twenty-five with the shared dispatch as its handler.

name: pair_slot_objects_and_swap
description: Marks this object as holding one of two shared slots. When both slots are occupied it links the pair, resets the slot counter, swaps their records into order, and moves the partner to state twenty-six. Otherwise it records a pending slot and clears the object's state byte.

name: set_state_from_argument_flagged
description: Sets a shared flag, stores the byte from data register D1 as the object's state, and installs the shared dispatch as its handler.

name: check_partner_contact_state
description: Sets a contact flag only when the linked partner's state is nonzero and this object sits seven units past the partner on a 14-unit grid. It then sets a shared flag, marks both objects when a counter is below four, and moves the object to state twenty-seven.

name: check_partner_contact_flag
description: Sets a contact flag when this object sits seven units past its linked partner on a 14-unit grid. It then sets a shared flag, marks both objects when a counter is below four, and moves the object to state twenty-seven.

name: snapshot_pair_state_or_wait
description: When a counter exceeds three and the contact flag is clear, copies this object's fields and its partner's record into a shared snapshot buffer and clears their link fields. Otherwise it moves the object to state twenty-eight.

name: set_state_twentyeight
description: Installs the shared dispatch as the object's handler and moves the object to state twenty-eight.

name: reset_pair_flags_state_twentynine
description: Resets a shared counter to three, clears the flags on the object and its partner, and moves the object to state twenty-nine with the shared dispatch as its handler.

name: advance_pair_index_state_thirty
description: Updates a shared pair index when the object is not aligned with its partner on a 14-unit grid, wrapping it after more than four steps. It sets a flag and moves the object to state thirty.

name: clear_flag_set_state_argument
description: Clears a shared flag, stores the byte from data register D1 as the object's state, and installs a dispatch pointer as its handler.

name: increment_counter_set_state
description: Increments a shared event counter and stores the byte from data register D1 as the object's state, with a dispatch pointer installed as its handler.

name: increment_second_counter_set_state
description: Increments a second shared event counter and stores the byte from data register D1 as the object's state, with a dispatch pointer installed as its handler.

name: dispatch_state_unless_flagged
description: When the argument byte in data register D1 is nonzero, it clears two offset fields and returns. Otherwise it zeroes the frame counter and runs the standard state dispatch.

name: dispatch_object_state_direct
description: Clears the frame counter and runs the object state switch directly, with no gate. Several state handlers call it to advance the object to its next state.

name: update_grid_cells_from_table
description: Walks a terminated table of rectangular regions. For each cell in a region it writes a two-bit value into a shared grid, stepping that value up or down by direction, and sets a companion marker. Cells are reached with a 24-byte row stride.

name: update_all_objects_then_reset
description: Runs the per-object update once for each of twenty-two object slots in unrolled calls, then sets a shared flag to one and clears a phase counter.

name: alternate_object_update_phases
description: Toggles a shared phase bit on each call. Depending on the phase it runs the per-object update for a set of slots, adding one more update when a flag is set, and then performs a final update.

name: reset_object_table_and_counters
description: Runs a table update, clears three shared counters and the state byte of twelve tracked objects, and when a flag is set marks two specific objects. It runs once at initialisation.

name: transform_pointer_table_entries
description: When a shared flag is zero, walks a table ending in a -1 sentinel, passes each entry's high word to a helper, and stores the helper's result back in that entry.

name: cycle_group_values_by_direction
description: Steps a shared cycle value between zero and nine, up or down according to the first object's state, and writes it to a group of linked objects, marking each as changed.

name: acquire_fixed_object_reference
description: Calls a helper with the constant 624 and stores the returned object reference in a shared variable.

name: cycle_object_value_from_table
description: Advances a four-bit cycle counter and writes the table value at its half-step index into the object's state byte, marking the object as changed.

name: initialize_sequence_state_fields
description: Clears two counters and sets a level value to 250. It sets two objects' state bytes from status bits and from an input value taken modulo 137, and forces default values when a shared mode is zero.

name: update_sequence_per_frame
description: Advances a per-frame sequencer: it steps two cycle values, clamps a level value between zero and 511, and updates table-driven values for several linked objects. Sub-counters reset when thresholds are crossed.

name: initialize_object_state_pair
description: Clears counters and sets two shared flags. It sets an object's state to four, or to zero when a status bit reported by a helper is set.

name: spawn_periodic_object_from_pool
description: Counts down a spawn timer and, when it expires, alternates between two spawn kinds. It finds a free record in a pool of forty entries and initialises its position, timer and state from a lookup table, setting the matching request flag.

name: initialize_timed_sequence_state
description: Sets an active flag, loads a 1250-tick timer and a 10-tick period, and clears the state bytes of two objects. It runs once when a timed sequence starts.

name: advance_timed_sequence_per_frame
description: While the timer runs it counts down and toggles a phase value each period, updating the state bytes of several objects. When the timer expires it clears the active flags and advances the remaining sequence counters.

name: sync_object_state_from_shared
description: Copies a shared byte into the object's state byte when the two differ, and marks the object as changed.

name: reset_pair_counters_and_states
description: Clears four shared counters and the state bytes of two objects. It runs after a helper call that prepares the shared tables.

name: update_counter_states_with_decay
description: Copies two shared counters, capped at four, into two object state bytes when they differ. It then reduces two accumulators by two, flooring each at zero.

name: initialize_sequence_counters_and_states
description: Clears three shared counters and sets two enable flags. It sets the state bytes of four objects to zero, zero, three and zero, after a helper call.

name: advance_state_cycle_when_enabled
description: When an enable flag and a counter are both set, advances the object's state byte modulo four and clears the counter when the state wraps to zero.

name: advance_cycle_load_table_entry
description: Advances a second object's state cycle like its neighbour. While a countdown is nonzero it decrements it and loads the object's handler and state byte from two lookup tables.

name: load_table_entry_from_index
description: Decrements the index in data register D1, loads the object's handler and state byte from the table entries at that index, and returns the status bits in D0 combined with three.

name: reset_shared_flags_and_states
description: Clears shared counters and flags. When a sequence counter is below ten it zeroes two object states; otherwise it sets one state to four or zero from a status bit and sets the other to match.

name: step_state_toward_target
description: Steps one object's state byte down toward zero or up toward four, depending on the other object's state and a countdown flag. It then copies both states into two shared values.

name: reset_flags_and_two_states
description: Clears two shared flags and zeroes the state bytes of two objects, after a helper call.

name: cycle_two_states_when_flagged
description: When their shared flags are set, cycles the state bytes of two objects through the values zero to two.

name: initialize_playfield_resources
description: Loads the background and drop picture resources through a helper when the setup flag is clear. It then resets shared counters, scroll values and a list of object states, and when more than one player is active it starts six sub-sequences.

name: advance_drop_sequence_per_frame
description: Advances a per-frame drop sequence: it cycles a state byte through zero to five and copies it to two linked objects. During its spawn phase it writes twelve child records from lookup tables, and it sets a flag when the cycle completes.

name: select_group_table_entry
description: Stores a group index in a shared slot when that slot is empty, and looks up a table entry for the group from the index and a shared offset.

name: select_group_record_entry
description: Stores the group index held in the record's word field in a shared slot, and looks up the matching table entry from that index and a shared offset.

name: setup_blitter_copy_operation
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, then programs its first and last word masks, modulo, source and destination pointers from a table entry and a shared base, and sets the blit size register.

name: initialize_channel_objects
description: Resets bound and counter fields and clears a list of object states. It installs handler pointers with fixed frame and position values for six channels, and for higher mode values it also reads two flags to set two object states.

name: advance_channel_animations_per_frame
description: Advances per-frame animation for a set of channels: it cycles state bytes through twelve values, steps blit source offsets by table entries, and advances a list of object states. When counters reach their limits it reloads them and sets the next resource offset.

name: advance_second_channel_animations
description: Mirrors the first channel's per-frame animation: it cycles a state byte through twelve values, steps a second set of blit source offsets, and reloads its counters at their limits to set the next resource offset.

name: initialize_indicator_states
description: Clears a shared index and two object states, then sets one state to one when a mode counter is below four. Otherwise it takes that state from a status bit reported by a helper.

name: advance_indicator_frames
description: When enabled, advances an indicator state modulo five and writes a frame value from a table at each step of a 32-step counter, reduced by an offset when a flag is set. When disabled it clears the indicator states.

name: initialize_paired_indicator_states
description: Sets two shared flags from a mode counter or from status bits reported by a helper, clears six object states, and sets two of them to one or to a status-derived value.

name: advance_paired_indicator_cycles
description: Advances an indicator state modulo eight and toggles a shared flag on wrap. It sets a second object to a value depending on that flag, then advances a timed state modulo four and eight when enabled.

name: advance_second_indicator_cycles
description: Mirrors the paired indicator update for the second pair: it advances its state modulo eight, toggles a flag on wrap, and steps a timed state modulo four and eight when enabled.

name: copy_tile_block_to_bitplanes
description: When the mode counter is above five, waits for the blitter and copies a block of tile words from a source table to three rows of bitplane addresses. Each row steps the plane addresses by 68 bytes, and the copy uses a fixed blit size.

name: initialize_indicator_pair_states
description: Clears two shared counters and sets two object states to four or zero, or to values derived from status bits reported by a helper. It then stores the next frame index for each indicator.

name: cycle_indicator_frames_from_table
description: Advances two indicator counters, cycling each through a table of frame values, and writes the frame minus one into each indicator's state byte. A counter that reaches its limit increments the matching level value.

name: reset_indicator_flags_and_states
description: Clears two shared flags and zeroes the state bytes of three objects, after a helper call.

name: advance_table_indexed_states
description: When a shared index is nonzero, writes table values into two object states and advances the index modulo sixteen. A second index drives a third state modulo eight.

name: initialize_five_object_states
description: Clears two shared counters and sets the state of five objects, the first to five and the rest to zero, after a helper call.

name: step_indicator_pair_toward_targets
description: Decrements one indicator state and increments another until both reach their targets, then advances the shared index that selects the active pair.

name: initialize_countdown_indicators
description: Sets two countdown values to nine or zero depending on a mode counter, clears ten object states, and sets two indicator states from the countdowns.

name: advance_countdown_indicators_per_frame
description: Per frame it cycles nine object states through zero to two and steps a countdown across pairs of indicator states, wrapping at twenty-nine. A secondary counter in three-step groups advances the active indicator and clears it at the end.

name: initialize_four_counter_states
description: Clears four shared counters and the state bytes of four objects, plus two more shared counters, after a helper call.

name: clamp_counters_into_states
description: Clamps two shared counters at four and copies them into two object state bytes. It then reduces two accumulators by two, flooring them at zero, and drains two queued table values into object states.

name: set_two_states_to_three
description: Calls a helper, then sets the state bytes of two objects to three.

name: combine_flags_into_indicator_states
description: Builds two indicator state bytes from combinations of shared flags. Each pair of flag conditions sets bits in its state byte, and the result is inverted before being stored.

name: initialize_indicator_layout
description: Sets four object states and two limit fields to fixed values when a mode counter is below twenty-six. Otherwise it derives the two limit fields from helper results, each reduced to three bits and multiplied by 204.

name: animate_two_meter_limits
description: Once a mode counter exceeds twenty-five, moves two meter limits up by a fixed step to a ceiling, drains table entries into a queue, and steps the meter values down. A meter snaps to its ceiling when its queue counter reaches three.

name: initialize_meter_state_values
description: Clears a list of object states and sets two meter values from helper results reduced modulo five, or to four and forty by default. It also resets a counter.

name: update_meter_pattern_per_frame
description: Per frame it updates a meter from the difference of two values, clamps it between zero and seventy, and derives a block index and several object states from it. It also cycles a pattern counter and toggles pulse states.

name: fill_table_with_pseudorandom_values
description: Fills 104 words with pseudo-random values reduced modulo 625, using a linear congruential generator with a fixed seed, multiplier and increment.

name: draw_sprite_records_via_blitter
description: Walks a list of sprite records until one lies past the visible bound. For each matching record it computes the clipped screen position and width, then programs the blitter and draws three columns of source words with shifted masks.

name: draw_sprite_range_via_blitter
description: Draws sprite records whose horizontal extent overlaps a visible column range. Each record is clipped to that range, and the blitter is programmed to draw its three columns of source words with shifted masks.

name: initialize_blit_object_fields
description: Sets the object's position fields from two input coordinates scaled to a 160-byte row, clears its counters, and writes a fill pattern to the blitter eight times while waiting for it to become idle.

name: initialize_display_table_pointers
description: Sets four table pointers from a base address and performs setup calls, including two lookups with fixed constant arguments and a fill call, before returning.

name: store_display_entry_primary
description: Stores two word values from its arguments into shared display fields, subtracting a shared offset from the second, and then calls a helper with argument one.

name: store_display_entry_secondary
description: Stores two word values from its arguments into a second set of shared display fields, subtracting a shared offset from the second, and then calls a helper with argument zero.

name: store_argument_pairs_in_fields
description: Stores four word values from its two argument pairs into four shared fields, one word per field.

name: copy_frame_into_display_buffer
description: For an entry index other than minus one, copies a 16-block graphic frame from a table into one of two display buffers chosen by a flag. Frames marked with a particular status bit are passed to two helper calls instead.

name: expand_record_bytes_to_plane
description: Converts sixty-eight four-field records by looking up each field in a byte table and writing the four results to an output buffer.

name: convert_records_until_sentinel
description: Repeatedly converts four-field records through a byte lookup table, writing four bytes per record to an output buffer, until a counter reaches minus one.

name: build_display_list_entries
description: Builds six pointer entries from a lookup table and swaps two buffer pointers, calling a helper after each swap. It then fills two more entries with fixed sentinel values and fixed coordinate values.

name: build_sprite_display_entries
description: When the index is minus one, resets four display entries to blank values. Otherwise it clips a vertical span against the visible range and writes four display list entries with pointers into the sprite buffer and fixed position words.

name: advance_cycle_and_draw_step
description: Advances a twelve-step cycle counter, then when the first argument is positive divides a span by the second argument to get a step. It issues helper calls with the derived position, with fixed values before and after.

name: queue_visible_sprite_blits
description: Walks a list of sprite records and, for each one inside the horizontal screen range, computes its clipped columns and programs the blitter with its address, size and mask. It appends the queued entries to an output list and returns the final count.

name: store_blit_request_fields
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, then stores the caller's pointers and size word in the object's blit request fields.

name: clip_and_queue_sprite_list
description: Walks a linked list of sprite records from the queue head, clipping each to the visible range and programming the blitter with its address, modulo and size.

name: store_word_argument_in_field
description: Stores the word passed in the argument into a shared field used as an offset for the list heads.

name: initialize_two_list_heads
description: Points the list head at a base buffer and a second head at that buffer plus a stored offset, sets the offset to 6000, clears the first word of both heads, then calls a helper.

name: run_entries_until_terminator
description: Walks a zero-terminated list, passing each entry to a helper that returns the next entry, until an entry's first word is zero.

name: run_scripted_task_list
description: Steps through a list of scripted tasks, interpreting each task's command code. Commands advance counters, read positions from a command stream and apply offsets, and tasks end when their script finishes.

name: queue_overlapping_boxes
description: Swaps two list heads, then for each object record computes the intersection of its box with a clip rectangle and queues any overlap through a helper. It then passes each entry of the second list to the same helper.

name: forward_record_fields_to_helper
description: Reads three fields from a record and passes them to a helper call.

name: poll_until_helper_ready
description: Issues setup helper calls depending on two flag bits, then polls a helper until it reports a nonzero result. It returns that result plus a shared offset.

name: multiply_then_divide_words
description: Multiplies two 16-bit values and divides the product by a third. It returns the remainder in the high word and the quotient in the low word.

name: return_status_from_flag_bits
description: Calls a helper, then when flag bit fourteen is set it tests two helper results and returns one or two. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: initialize_three_flags
description: Clears one shared value and sets two other shared values to one.

name: run_helper_with_busy_flag
description: Sets a shared busy flag, calls a helper, then clears the flag.

name: store_argument_and_call_helper
description: Stores the word argument in a shared field and then calls a helper.

name: store_inverted_primary_flag
description: Stores the inverse of the argument's low bit in a shared enable flag.

name: store_inverted_secondary_flag
description: Stores the inverse of the argument's low bit in a second shared enable flag.

name: run_helper_with_argument_flag
description: Sets a shared busy flag, stores the word argument in a shared field, calls a helper, then clears the busy flag.

name: run_helper_with_nonzero_argument
description: When the word argument is nonzero, sets a busy flag, stores the argument in a shared field, calls a helper, then clears the busy flag.

name: run_helper_five_times_enabled
description: When a shared flag is nonzero, calls a helper five times in sequence.

name: run_helper_three_times_enabled
description: When a shared flag is nonzero, calls a helper three times in sequence.

name: queue_sound_on_free_channel
description: Assigns a pending sound request to a free audio channel slot. When a request is active it fills the first free of three slots, otherwise it starts the request on the primary channel by calling a helper and records it.

name: clear_sound_request_on_channel
description: Compares the pending sound request with the four audio channel slots and, on a match, calls a helper for that channel. It then clears the request.

name: reset_audio_channel_state
description: Writes fixed parameter values into four channel entries, then clears the channel slot variables and pending sound requests.

name: load_instrument_entry_set
description: Sets a busy flag and clears a 204-word work buffer. When a stored index is nonzero it loads four pointers from a 16-byte-per-entry table, binds them to channel records, and assigns eight channel identifiers.

name: update_audio_channels_per_frame
description: Runs once per frame when the busy flag is clear. It checks each audio channel slot and calls helpers to update volume or period for active channels, choosing the path with a mute flag.

name: forward_call_to_helper
description: Calls a helper routine and returns, with no other work.

name: latch_indexed_entry_and_clear
description: Copies a table entry selected by a shared index into a second shared slot, then clears the index and a companion value.

name: forward_call_to_helper
description: Its decompiled body is a single helper call followed by a return, so it only forwards the call to that helper.

name: latch_indexed_entry_second_slot
description: Copies a table entry selected by a second shared index into another shared slot, then clears that index and a companion value.

name: step_audio_voice_sequence
description: Advances one audio voice's note sequence. When the duration expires it reads the next command word from the stream, applies a stored volume and an optional slide or repeat, then writes the resulting period and sample pointer to its channel and touches the DMA control register.

name: read_next_audio_event
description: Loads the next duration from an audio stream, then reads the following value and applies the voice's pitch offset to it before storing the result in the channel period field. A terminator byte repeats the previous value.

name: start_audio_voice_sequence
description: Starts an audio voice from a sequence pointer. It reads the first command word and returns if it is zero, otherwise it initialises the voice's duration, pointer and volume fields and writes the first period to the channel.

name: start_voice_after_clearing_bit
description: Clears one control bit in the CIA port register, then starts the audio voice from the sequence pointer in the same way as its neighbour.

name: start_voice_after_setting_bit
description: Sets one control bit in the CIA port register, then starts the audio voice from the sequence pointer in the same way as its neighbour.
